intact.visualMeshLimit: Procedural manager draws have no MeshFilter. Owned mesh/material counts are reported once per manager; private mesh vertex data is not exposed and is NOT folded into mounted chunk vertices.
intact.visualConservation: Physical cells and per-runtime DetachedVisualCells are counted once per runtime. VoxelDetachedVisualFragments.CellCount/FragmentCount are manager-wide and counted once per manager, never multiplied by the runtime count.
intact.physicsNote: Non-preview EditMode instances own one Rigidbody and enabled active compound BoxColliders. VoxelTerrainColliders may retain unused pooled components disabled after compaction: activeColliderComponents is the runtime ColliderCount / active physical volume, pooledColliderComponents are disabled retained components and are NOT physical colliders. The profiler never calls Physics.Simulate, so this is not a physics, contact, gravity or gameplay measurement.
intact.drawsNote: rendererDrawUpperBound = sum of active MeshRenderer material slots, an upper bound on MeshRenderer draw calls. Real GPU draw calls/batching are not measurable in Editor edit mode. Visual-fragment draws are submitted by LateUpdate, which the Editor does not run here, so SubmittedDrawCount stays 0 and is not invented.
intact.allocationNote: allocatedBytes are current-thread managed allocations only and are valid only when report.allocation.supported is true; otherwise they are the -1 sentinel and must not be interpreted as zero. Native mesh/PhysX/GPU memory is not measured and is never added to managed bytes.
intact.hitTotalNote: First-hit and flush CPU totals include full first renderer activation: chunk GameObjects, MeshFilters, MeshRenderers, materials and bindings are created inside the timed call. They are not split into hidden sub-phases.
